scheduling: map=i%6, pair=(i/6)%16, first=pair/4, second=pair%4; swap first/second on odd i; seed=base+i*104729 (Int32 wrap)
metricDefinitions: All aggregate rows exclude error, unresolved and cancelled matches. Detailed logs retain their match IDs.
appearances counts admitted draws, grants and UNKNOWN creation, including redraws; overflow goes directly to discardedUnused.
opportunities counts decision points with a legal summon/gamble, once per instance at that decision; it is not a count of distinct turns.
matchesUsed is distinct games; playerMatchesUsed counts player-game exposures. usageWinRate=winsUsed/playerMatchesUsed.
Survival uses global alternating turns, from summon until death or match end. Censored survivors are marked separately.
Damage is capped to actual remaining HP; counterattacks are attributed to their real source. Self damage is separate.
attackDamage+effectDamage is damage directly dealt. buffExtraDamage is a separate attributed contribution and must not be added to game-wide dealt damage.

Attack grants use a no-grant counterfactual capped by victim HP, divided proportionally among positive grants; weakening uses the corresponding no-debuff counterfactual. These are attribution estimates, not independent causal effects.
Additional HP absorption uses a base-HP-first pool with proportional grant consumption. Healing does not replenish consumed grant pools. Map grants remain separate.

Effect applications count resolved targets, including skipped/cancelled attempts; activations deduplicate source instance and effect index. Zero results include capped healing, empty decks and absent targets.
No shield or direct damage-reduction mechanic exists in the current card database. These columns are not_applicable.
Joker success/failure records and stat vectors are separate units; average gain/loss derives from totals divided by each outcome count. Forced map gambles are included with zero paid mana.
Zero paid mana efficiency is not applicable, encoded by status and blank CSV cells. JSON numeric placeholder zero must be interpreted with the status.
AI policies see only existing recipient-filtered observations. They do not inspect hidden opponent hands or deck order, or score poker synergies.
Safety limits mark unresolved matches without awarding wins. No fatigue or sudden-death rule is introduced.
Candidate thresholds are screening heuristics, not validated balance scores; low-sample cards remain explicitly insufficient_sample.
Descriptions are exported verbatim. Semantic agreement between prose and mechanics requires the deterministic fixtures and manual review.
